description_en: Changes the endpoint type of one or more hosts for O\\\\\\&M. Public and private IP addresses are supported
description_zh: 堡垒机支持公网运维和私网运维，您可以通过本接口修改运维主机时使用的连接地址类型
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-hosts-active-address-type --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-ids '["1","2"]' --active-address-type Private --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostsActiveAddressType

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to change the portal type of the host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to change the portal type of the host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。

区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host for which you want to change the portal type. The value is a JSON string. You can add up to 100 host IDs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the ID of the host
parameters.help_zh:
要修改连接地址类型的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多可输入100个主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_ids

parameters.help_en:
The new portal type of the host. Valid values:

Public: public portal

Private: internal portal
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的主机连接地址的类型。取值：

Public：公网
Private：私网
parameters.name: active_address_type
